title: images result record (v1)
description: One logical images search result as one JSONL result record: the original zero-based position in the upstream results array, the constant images bucket, and the usable textual members the upstream result carried — the result page url plus the full-size and thumbnail image urls. Absent members are omitted, never emitted as null.

url.$comment: The result page the image was found on.

image.$comment: The full-size image url the result points at.

thumbnail.$comment: The thumbnail image url of the result.
